use default
use System.StringSplitOptions

let bars = "▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█"

let separators = [' ', ',', '\t']

bar(value: double, lowest: double, span: double) -> char =>
    if span == 0.0 then
        bars[0]
    else
        bars[cast int((value - lowest) * 7.999 / span)]
    fi

sparkline(series: string) -> string is
    let values =
        series.split(separators, StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)
        |> map(text => double.parse(text))
        |> collect_list()

    let ordered = values |> sort() |> collect_list()

    let lowest = ordered[0]
    let highest = ordered[ordered.count - 1]
    let span = highest - lowest

    write_line("min {lowest}, max {highest}")

    return string(values |> map(value => bar(value, lowest, span))
                         |> collect_array())
si

for series in [
    "1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 1",
    "1.5, 0.5 3.5, 2.5 5.5, 4.5 7.5, 6.5",
    "0, 1, 19, 20",
    "0, 999, 4000, 4999, 7000, 7999"
] do
    write_line(sparkline(series))
    write_line("")
